items.prompt: Write a 5-sentence opinion piece about whether students should be allowed to choose their own seats in the classroom. Include a topic sentence, two reasons with different linking words, and a strong closing sentence.
items.answer: Sample: I believe students should be allowed to choose their own seats in the classroom. Students who pick their own seats are happier because they feel respected and trusted by their teacher. Also, choosing a seat helps students because they can sit away from distractions and next to someone who helps them focus. Furthermore, allowing this choice teaches responsibility and shows students that good decisions lead to good results. For all of these reasons, I believe students should earn the right to pick where they sit.

items.prompt:
Read this opinion piece and identify TWO problems with it. Then rewrite the entire piece to fix both problems.

'I think dogs are nice. They are fluffy. Dogs bark sometimes. I have a dog named Max. Max likes bones. Dogs are pets.'
items.answer: Problems: (1) There are no linking words connecting reasons to the opinion. (2) There is no closing sentence. Rewrite: 'I think dogs make the best pets. Dogs are wonderful because they are loyal and always happy to see you come home. Also, dogs are great companions because they love to play and can even learn fun tricks. That is why every family should have a dog.'

steps: Problem 1: No linking words (no 'because,' 'and,' or 'also' connecting reasons to the opinion).
Rewrite must fix both problems by adding linking words and a closing sentence.

items.prompt: Write a 5-sentence opinion piece arguing that students should be required to do community service. Your piece must include: a topic sentence, two reasons (each with a linking word), one piece of evidence or example, and a closing sentence.
items.answer: Sample: I believe that all students should be required to do community service. Community service is valuable because it teaches kids to care about others and think beyond themselves. Also, helping the community is rewarding because students feel proud when they see how their work makes a real difference. For example, students who clean up a local park help make their neighborhood safer and more beautiful for everyone. That is why I think community service should be a required part of every school year.

items.prompt:
A student wrote this opinion piece. It has three errors: a missing reason, a sentence that is off-topic, and a weak closing. Identify each error and rewrite the piece.

'I think every school should have a garden. Gardens help students learn about science. My favorite flower is a sunflower. That is the end.'
items.answer: Error 1: Missing second reason. Error 2: Off-topic sentence ('My favorite flower is a sunflower'). Error 3: Weak closing ('That is the end'). Rewrite: 'I think every school should have a garden. Gardens help students learn about science because they can watch plants grow and understand how food is made. Also, gardens are a great activity because students work together and learn to care for living things. That is why every school should make room for a garden.'

steps: Identify and remove the off-topic sentence.
Add a second reason with 'also' and 'because.'
Replace the weak closing with one that restates the opinion.

items.prompt:
Write a counterargument opinion piece. First, state one reason someone might disagree with this opinion. Then explain why you still believe the opinion is correct.

Opinion: 'I think students should spend more time reading for fun.'
items.answer: Sample: I think students should spend more time reading for fun. Some people might say that students already have too much to read for school and do not have time for extra reading. However, I still believe reading for fun is important because choosing your own books makes reading exciting and helps you want to read more. Also, reading stories and adventures that you love builds your vocabulary and imagination in ways that school books sometimes cannot. For these reasons, making time for fun reading is one of the best things a student can do.

steps: Acknowledge a counterargument with 'Some people might say.'
Rebut with 'However, I still believe' and a 'because' reason.

items.prompt:
Rank these three topic sentences from weakest (1) to strongest (3) for an opinion piece about school lunches. Explain your ranking.

A) School lunches exist.
B) I think school lunches are okay.
C) I believe that school lunches should be healthier so that all students have the energy they need to learn.
items.answer: 1 (weakest): A — it is just a fact, not an opinion. 2: B — it states a vague opinion but gives no hint of the reasons. 3 (strongest): C — it states a clear opinion AND hints at the reason ('so that students have energy to learn').

steps: A is not an opinion at all.
B is an opinion but too vague.
C is the strongest because it names the opinion AND connects to a reason.

items.prompt: Write a 5-sentence opinion piece about whether school should be year-round. Your piece must include the linking words 'because,' 'also,' and 'for these reasons.'
items.answer: Sample: I believe that school should not be year-round. A long summer break is important because students need time to rest and recharge after a hard year of learning. Also, summer is valuable because children can explore their interests, go to camp, spend time with family, and discover who they are outside of school. Children who have a real break often come back to school in the fall feeling refreshed and excited to learn again. For these reasons, I think keeping a long summer vacation is the best choice for students.

items.prompt: Write two different topic sentences for the same opinion: 'Students should exercise more.' Make one topic sentence weak and one strong. Then explain what makes the strong one better.
items.answer: Weak: 'I think exercising is good.' Strong: 'I believe that students should exercise for at least 30 minutes every day because it helps them stay healthy and focused in school.' Explanation: The strong sentence is better because it names a specific amount, uses 'I believe,' and hints at the reasons.  The weak sentence is too vague.

steps: Weak topic sentence: vague, no detail.
Strong topic sentence: specific, uses 'I believe,' hints at reasons.
Explanation: strong sentences give the reader a clear preview of the argument.

items.prompt: Write an opinion piece with exactly 5 sentences arguing that students should learn a second language starting in kindergarten. Use at least three different linking words.
items.answer: Sample: I strongly believe that children should start learning a second language in kindergarten. Learning a new language is easier when you are young because young brains absorb new sounds and words quickly. Also, speaking two languages is helpful because it opens up more friendships and opportunities in life. Furthermore, students who learn languages early often do better in other subjects because learning a language builds memory and problem-solving skills. For all of these reasons, second-language learning should begin on the very first day of school.

steps: 5 sentences: topic sentence, three reason sentences with different linking words (because/also/furthermore), closing sentence with 'For all of these reasons.'

items.prompt:
Edit this opinion piece for THREE specific improvements: (1) add a second reason, (2) improve the closing sentence, (3) add at least one more linking word.

'I think every student should keep a journal. Writing every day helps you become a better writer. Good writers are important.'
items.answer: Improved piece: 'I think every student should keep a journal. Writing every day helps you become a better writer because practice makes you faster and more confident with words. Also, keeping a journal is great because you can save your memories and look back at them when you are older. For these reasons, a personal journal is one of the most useful tools a student can have.'

steps: Add 'because' to the existing reason for improvement.
Add a second reason starting with 'Also' and including 'because.'
Replace the weak closing with 'For these reasons, ...'

items.prompt: Write a 5-sentence opinion piece about whether schools should ban sugary drinks. Include a topic sentence, two reasons with linking words, one specific example, and a strong closing.
items.answer: Sample: I believe that schools should ban sugary drinks. Sugary drinks are harmful because they contain a lot of sugar that can hurt children's teeth and lead to health problems. Also, sweet drinks like soda can cause a sugar crash that makes kids tired and unable to focus during class. For example, studies show that students who drink water instead of soda have more energy and better concentration throughout the school day. For these reasons, I think replacing sugary drinks with water and milk is one of the smartest choices a school can make.

items.prompt: A classmate says that an opinion piece does not need a closing sentence. Do you agree or disagree? Write a 3-sentence response using opinion writing skills.
items.answer: Sample: I disagree that an opinion piece can skip the closing sentence. A closing sentence is important because it ties the whole piece together and leaves the reader with a clear memory of your opinion. Without a closing, the piece feels unfinished, just like a story that stops in the middle.

steps: Add a third sentence explaining the consequence of having no closing.

items.prompt: Write an opinion piece about whether it is more important to be kind or to be smart. Your piece must be 4-5 sentences and include two different linking words.
items.answer: Sample: I believe that being kind is more important than being smart. Kindness matters more because how you treat other people affects everyone around you every single day. Also, being kind is powerful because a kind person builds friendships and creates a world that is safer and happier for everyone. A very smart person who is not kind can still cause harm, but a kind person will almost always do good. For these reasons, I believe kindness is the greatest quality a person can have.

items.prompt:
This opinion piece contradicts itself. Find the contradiction and rewrite the piece so the reasons support the opinion.

'I think students should get more recess. Too much time outside is a waste. Students need exercise and fresh air. That is why recess is important.'
items.answer: Contradiction: 'Too much time outside is a waste' argues against the opinion. Rewrite: 'I think students should get more recess. More time outside is valuable because exercise gives students energy and helps them focus better when they return to class. Also, recess is important because it gives students a mental break, which makes it easier to learn new things. That is why every student deserves more time for recess.'

steps: Identify the contradicting sentence (the second sentence argues against the opinion).
Replace it with a reason that supports the opinion.
Make sure all sentences point in the same direction.

items.prompt: Write a complete 5-sentence opinion piece on a topic of your choice. Your piece must include: a strong topic sentence, two reasons each with a different linking word, one example or detail, and a closing sentence that does not start with 'That is why.'
items.answer: Sample (topic: field trips): I believe that every class should go on at least two field trips a year. Field trips are valuable because students get to learn outside the classroom in a way that feels exciting and real. Also, visiting museums or nature centers is important because it brings lessons to life and helps students remember what they learned. For example, a student who visits a science museum can touch real fossils and see how ancient animals lived, which no textbook can match. I am certain that field trips create some of the most powerful learning memories a student will ever have.

steps: Closing sentence using different language (not 'That is why').
